info.name: BlockAuth API
info.description:
Manual and regression checks for the BlockAuth API. Start the local stack, then run the folders in order: "Get CSRF token" stores the token that every later POST sends.

Postman cannot produce MetaMask signatures. For the requests marked USER or ADMIN, log in through the browser and copy the value of the BLOCKAUTH_SESSION cookie into the userSession or adminSession variable. Those requests are skipped while the variable is empty. The CSRF token does not need copying.

Run this collection only against your own local or test environment. It deliberately sends failing requests, which are recorded as security events.

item.name: Admin
item.description: Needs the adminSession variable: log in through the browser with a wallet listed in BLOCKAUTH_ADMIN_WALLETS and copy the value of the BLOCKAUTH_SESSION cookie. Set adminWallet to that wallet's address. Changes that need a fresh wallet signature (revoke, reactivate, emergency stop, flags, API keys) cannot be signed from Postman, so the collection checks that they are refused without one; the two targetWallet requests run only when targetWallet names a registered, non-administrator wallet.
